coverage: 35 ZIP entries; recomputed 34 named manifest fingerprints and lengths plus manifest digest, verified membership including manifest, no traversal or duplicates. Full hashes in member-hashes.json. Public package has target-specific IL, RES, instructions, tool sources, licensed dependencies, replay data and evidence. Only local installed Aspen path in instructions is explicit replay input.

Source run uses python -I -B from an empty directory with 13 copied inputs. No original DLL, original-build/, layout recipe, operand map, evidence, verifier assemblies or external pip packages present in that directory. Reviewed entry point and source-side helper reads. Native ILASM input: editable IL plus RES. Source normalizes only MVID/timestamp/checksum and one named Param metadata entry. No original code, metadata or replay bytes fetched by that path. The genuine native VERSION data and the assembly public key are explicit original-derived source material.

Independent per-file raw PE32/CLR reader imports only Python standard library. Decodes all populated table schemas. Decodes 42 MethodDef declarations and all 5 CIL bodies including original and independent token namespaces; resolves each reference to its owner, method/field/type signature and assembly scope. Matches all opcodes/operands, branches, stack, local types, init flags, and exception regions. Used reflection opcode specifications of installed PowerShell runtime; no attempt to execute target assembly. Method-level details in independent-results.json; package Mono.Cecil comparer rerun separately against fresh output, matched all declarations, bodies and module model.

18 abstract plus 19 runtime-coded remaining declarations have zero RVA in both. 8 TypeDefs including <Module>, 4 fields, 8 InterfaceImpl, 18 MethodImpl, 56 custom attributes with constructor binding/owner/blob, 22 FieldMarshal with owner/blob and one mscorlib external identity matched. Independent comparisons in declarations-results.json.

506 CIL instruction bytes. Five original and replayed method spans by token (0x06000026..2A) were 36,283,46,200,31 bytes. All 596 bytes include method headers, alignment and EH. Source semantic equality includes 31 CIL token occurrences. Historical review assigned 176 bytes to Finalize and 572 total. Small section at offset 172 is 28 bytes with 4-byte header and two 12-byte clauses, ending at 200. Historical count omitted exactly the two clause records. Catch System.Exception covers [0,133) with handler [133,139); finally covers [0,144) with handler [144,157). Unused finally token union is original 0x01000000, independent output 0; runtime-dispatch meaning identical.

All original native resource subtrees traversed. Single 16/1/0 RT_VERSION payload: 716 bytes, language 0, codepage 0, digest 060c617bcd34faf32e856d402cb262f89b56e2da24513c4334ae49601e6eeebc. Packed RES supplies same bytes; independent built resource is equal. No CLR resource directory or ManifestResource, no WPF/UI framework reference, BAML, managed EventMap or PropertyMap. Imported dialog interfaces, sink, event provider and COM calls preserved. This wrapper contains no local WPF layout or bindings.

Param 38 -> 33: ILASM omits six empty return Param rows (MethodDefs 02,03,08,15,16,1b hexadecimal) and creates one empty arg row for RID 28 hexadecimal. Original constructor had no Param row. Raw source ILASM called that arg A_0. Directive-gated narrow normalizer zeroed its name, preserving row and semantic absence of name/default/attributes/marshal. Independent check of raw, normalized and original in declarations-results.json. Source TypeRef 29->27 and MemberRef 25->24 omit unused MarshalAsAttribute+UnmanagedType and ctor. StandAloneSig 3->2 omits unused-shape zero-local signature; all locals and actual typed/marshal contracts match.

Replay explicitly requires original hash and pinned ILASM. Five archived text-prefix method windows are all zero. Reviewed actual position patcher/replay entrypoints and RE recipe; independently derived 31 IL binding positions matched all supplied positions. For these five spans, before/after translated intermediate differ at 25 four-byte header/operand/EH fields sourced from original (28 individual differing bytes in 100 bytes worth of fields); all other bytes unchanged. Whole method bodies are sourced from translated compiled IL. Final 596 bytes are byte-equal. Source normalizer is not used in replay; compilation strips the public key only in the replay intermediate.

Replay retains PE header/layout and .text prefix outside the 5 body windows, restores strong-name bytes separately, reuses complete original CLR metadata (#~, #Strings, #US, #GUID, #Blob), .rsrc/.reloc, native bootstrap layout, original signed 128-byte strong name and 10,280-byte certificate table. Native bootstrap emitted using intermediate data and recipe. Raw replay file equals 17,960-byte original. Independent source output is 7,680 bytes with same public key and assembly identity, empty 128-byte signature slot, CLR flags 1 vs original 9 and no certificate table, differing MVID/COFF timestamp/PE checksum. No private signing key used.
